headline: DBS Denies Rumor of Indonesia Bank Central Asia Merger After Stock Rally
summary: DBS Group said there is no truth to rumors that its Indonesian unit will merge with Bank Central Asia, following a jump in BCA's share price.
why: DBS is Southeast Asia's largest financial institution, while Bank Central Asia is Indonesia's largest private lender by market value.

impacts.name: Bank Central Asia
impacts.why: Unverified merger speculation pushed shares higher before official corporate denials moderated market buying.

why_moved: Unsubstantiated consolidation reports triggered buying in BCA shares before DBS issued a official clarification.
